title: The New Pact of Suite 214/216
summary: On Saturday, January 24, 2015, after two weeks of classes and quiet reflection in Suite 214/216, Jordan, Aubrie Jean, Madison, Zoë, Lauren, and Hannah gather in Room 214 with Mark, Sarah, and Jessica's blessing to formalize the New Pact—transforming their protective huddle into a conscious, loving polyamorous commitment grounded in the No-Jealousy Rule.

scenes.title: The First Night of the New Pact
